title: Model Integration and Testing
summary: This module contains comprehensive integration tests for the model serving system, validating API functionality, model capabilities, performance, and concurrency under various conditions.

nodes.label: API & Basic Functionality Tests
nodes.title: API & Basic Functionality Tests
nodes.description: Validates core API endpoints and fundamental system behaviors, including Unicode handling and basic chat/generate operations.

nodes.label: Model Capabilities Tests
nodes.title: Model Capabilities Tests
nodes.description: Verifies specific model capabilities such as audio processing, image generation, embeddings, quantization, tool calling, and multi-modal vision.

nodes.label: Performance & Concurrency Tests
nodes.title: Performance & Concurrency Tests
nodes.description: Evaluates system performance, concurrency, and context handling under various load conditions and for different models.

nodes.label: Library Model Tests
nodes.title: Library Model Tests
nodes.description: Focuses on testing the chat capabilities of various models available in the library, ensuring expected responses to specific prompts.

nodes.label: API Endpoints
nodes.title: API Endpoints
nodes.description: The module providing the HTTP API for interacting with the model serving and management system.

nodes.label: Model Serving & Management
nodes.title: Model Serving & Management
nodes.description: Manages the lifecycle of models, including loading, unloading, scheduling, and serving responses to various API requests.

nodes.label: Model Creation & Conversion
nodes.title: Model Creation & Conversion
nodes.description: Handles the creation and conversion of models from various formats into the system's internal representation.

groups.label: Integration Test Suites
groups.title: Integration Test Suites
groups.description: A collection of test suites designed to validate various aspects of the model serving system, from basic API functionality to advanced model capabilities and performance under load.

groups.label: System Under Test
groups.title: System Under Test
groups.description: The core components of the model serving system that are being validated by the integration tests, including API interfaces, model lifecycle management, and model creation processes.
